summary: Phase S2 passes acceptance at 8bc7469a. The audited HEAD is current and equals the brief. I re-ran the full Green gate evidence myself at HEAD with a fresh label: the lint, test, and checks-all sweeps each print NEWFAIL=0, the workerd probe answers probe-ok, the targeted role filter passes 12/12, the F1 filter passes 4/4, and generate and doctor exit 0. The review chain is closed (A r4 and C r4 PASS at 8bc7469a; B r3 PASS at 15c1d523 and the only code delta to HEAD is the IM3 sanitizer that A and C re-reviewed). All five adversarial blockers are fixed and their tests pass at HEAD. The S2 Verify grep matches only test files. No blocking finding exists. Seven nonblocking findings stay record-only; three are Major deferrals the orchestrator already routed, and the rest are evidence-text and process records for the checkpoint and the next phase.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major, orchestrator-deferred] phase-acceptance: The BM2 lesson chatbot embeds lesson markdown into the studentTutor prompt without the stripPersonDetails fix. apps/bus-math-v2/app/api/student/lesson-chatbot/route.ts:175-178 maps phase.sections markdown into the prompt, and the IM3-only strip lives at apps/integrated-math-3/app/api/student/lesson-chatbot/route.ts:37-53. The BM2 no-PII test mocks assembleLessonChatbotContext and puts no fixture value into the lesson markdown (route.no-pii.test.ts:63-90), so the S2 story criterion for BM2 lesson markdown is unproven. Review B r3 reproduced the ADV-S2-4 fixture through the BM2 flow and routed the finding per the late-finding stop rule after round 2. Rationale: the spec invariant 'AI prompts contain no PII' is enforced in one sibling and not the other, but no live BM2 curriculum markdown holds a person detail today and the finding is on the accepted next-phase list. Fix: in S3, add the same strip to the BM2 route and a no-PII test that runs the real assembler with fixture PII in the lesson markdown.

F2 [Major, record-only] phase-acceptance: evidence.md line 288 claims 'F1 filter: 4 passed, exit 0' and cites green-s2-targeted-F1.log, but that log records 3 passed, 1 failed, exit 1: F1b failed at 11:06:17 with 'Body is unusable: Body has already been read' before the mid-Green fix. The behavior claim is true at HEAD: my re-run of the same filter gives 4 passed, exit 0, and every package suite since r1 passes. The cited log is the mid-fix record, not the proof. Rationale: the evidence text names a log that contradicts it, which fails the A5 artifact check for that one line. Fix: at the next evidence commit, cite the package-suite log or a fresh targeted F1 run for the 4/4 claim.

F3 [Major, record-only] phase-acceptance: the IM3 stripPersonDetails regex is fixture-shaped (Review B r3 F2). A dash form, an em-dash form, unlisted labels, prose names, an obfuscated email, and a fullwidth-unicode label all pass through unchanged; only the six listed colon labels and a bare RFC email are removed. The committed tests cover the colon-labeled fixture only. Accepted deferral on the next-phase list. Fix: in S3, replace the label list with a conservative sentence-level name detector or accept the limit in writing.

F4 [Major, record-only] phase-acceptance: MODEL_ID at packages/ai-tutoring/src/providers.ts:170 accepts a bare OpenRouter key form such as 'sk-or-v1-0123456789abcdef' as a served model, so a compromised upstream that echoes the bare key in the model field passes safeModel into the usage log (Review B r3 F3). The precondition is an upstream that already holds the key, so the marginal risk is the persisted copy in the log. Accepted deferral. Fix: in S3, record the model only when it equals the configured model or the configured model plus a known suffix.

F5 [Nit] phase-acceptance: measure/tech-stack.md keeps stale current-state lines that S1 acceptance F4 told S2 to fix in the same commit as the roles note. Line 73 says the provider calls OpenRouter through fetch; line 75 says the default model is openrouter/free through OPENROUTER_MODEL; lines 77 to 79 list the adopted SDK as planned; lines 254 to 264 quote the old IM3 .env.example with OPENROUTER_MODEL. The code reads roles with no default since S2. AGENTS.md says a current item must not read as planned. The S2 roles note at lines 81 to 89 is correct. Fix: in the S4 docs task or the next docs commit, write the current state and drop the planned marker for the SDK and the roles.

F6 [Nit] phase-acceptance: four process records need a PM decision or a small plan edit. (a) S2 ran three Green remediation rounds (r2 b212125b, r3 e5680156, r4 ea1e7920) and metadata.json holds no escalation key, which the Round limit requires for a third round; the r4 fix was a routed blocker fix with test-first proof and two PASS re-reviews. (b) The S2 Contract and S2 Test (Red) task lines in plan.md cite no commit SHA, although commits 8e803b83 and c80b7352 hold the work; the S1 pattern cites a SHA on each [x] task. (c) Eight measure/runs files were force-added and committed although the test strategy declares the folder gitignored. (d) Commit 1833c526 carries no git note. Fix: record the PM approval for the third round in metadata.json deviation_notes at the checkpoint, add the two SHA citations at the next plan edit, and keep run files out of later commits.

F7 [Nit, carried] phase-acceptance: carried next-phase items stay open and real: Review B r3 F4 (the cache key embeds a rotated API key in worker memory until clearProviderCache), F5 (both chatbot rate-limit catches log the raw error object, route.ts:196 IM3 and route.ts:102 BM2), N1 (OPENROUTER_DEBUG logs the auth header; pass a redacting debugLogger in S3), and S1 acceptance F2 (gates.sh cannot see a new or larger [EXCEEDS] BM2 bundle entry). My manual bundle comparison at HEAD shows the same two entries as the baseline with no budget change: [EXCEEDS] Total dist/server 10028.49 KB and [OK] server/index.js 1154.38 KB, and IM3 [OK] 292.85 KB.

That sanitizer delta is the r4 fix that Reviews A and C re-reviewed at 8bc7469a, and I read the matcher and its tests myself. adversarial-a34ab162 is FAIL with five blockers; Green r3 e5680156 and r4 ea1e7920 fixed them, and my sweeps at HEAD pass their tests.

Story S2 criterion 1 and 2: roles.test.ts cases 1 and 2 pass the configured value without change, and roles-preservation.test.ts proves resolveRoleModel returns the raw value (roles.ts:52). The re-run filter 'role configuration' passes 12 passed, 129 skipped, exit 0.

Story S2 fail-closed criteria: roles.test.ts cases 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10 assert the null return with the logged variable name and the structured reason 'preset' (the r2 change from toContain is disclosed in plan.md lines 269 to 272). role-configuration.adversarial.test.ts:150-190 proves the warm-cache re-check: providers.ts:406-427 reads the key and the role model before any cache read, and the cache key is role, key, and model.

Story S2 usage-record criterion: cases 3 and 11 pass; providers.ts:292-299 writes one record after success and :301-313 one record after the last retry; safeModel at :170-178 bounds the served model; mapSdkError at :96-103 keeps only the status for HTTP errors; the IM3 adversarial test proves a 401 body that echoes the question and the key reaches no console call.

Story S2 provider-object criterion: cases 4, 5, and 12 pass; roles.ts:67-83 returns undefined for the studentTutor pair and the SDK names requireParameters and zdr per F13; providers.ts:259 spreads provider only when the preferences object exists.

Story S2 no-PII criterion: IM3 is proven with the real assembler and the strip at route.ts:37-53, by route.s2.adversarial.test.ts and route.pii-scope.test.ts (the r4 fix bounds a clause at a line break, sentence end, or next label). BM2 is proven for session and account values only; the lesson-markdown path is finding F1.

S2 Verify grep: git grep -n "OPENROUTER_MODEL\b\|openrouter/free" -- apps packages ':!**/.env.example' matches only roles.test.ts:51,188,189 (the case-9 fixture, accepted N2) and role-configuration.adversarial.test.ts:88,139,158 (the live complement of case 9). No production code matches.

The workerd probe passes role 'studentTutor' and model 'probe/model' (worker.ts:17-18).

Red ran 12 failing cases first (red-s2-d8e08cde.log), the adversarial tests drive the real SDK, and route.pii-scope.test.ts failed before the r4 fix, but no test covers the BM2 lesson-markdown path and the F1 evidence log shows the mid-fix run.
